title: MZ-091 and MZ-096 quick-create reliability
request: Send only the password field applicable to a manual task type and keep every low-position quick-create input visible while the software keyboard changes size.
outcome: Check-in and checkout create payloads omit the inapplicable password field, while measured focus scrolling keeps inputs above the effective keyboard-adjusted footer and discards stale focus work.
implementation: Build the manual check-in or checkout payload with only its applicable password field, preserving an explicit null for a blank applicable value.
Calculate a bounded scroll target from measured field geometry, the scroll viewport window position, and the keyboard frame screen position.
Re-evaluate focused-field visibility after frame-only keyboard changes and multiline content growth, even when the ScrollView does not emit another layout event.
Clear keyboard and window geometry on every form-session reset so a closed form cannot influence a reopened form.
Add bottom scroll space for the fixed action footer while preserving existing permissions, draft retention, and single-flight save behavior.
impact_dependencies: No backend, database, migration, native dependency, package manifest, lockfile, environment, permission, or production-data change.
The local integration base includes the separately reviewed MZ-097 draft-recovery change, while this registration binds only the MZ-091 and MZ-096 hunks.
Physical-device Chinese input, candidate-bar resizing, and real iOS and Android keyboard behavior remain outside local mock validation.
validation: Focused integration coverage passes check-in and checkout field applicability, blank applicable values, retry retention, measured geometry, all create modes, frame-only keyboard resizing, close-and-reopen geometry reset, multiline growth, and stale callbacks.
The exact combined Mobile gate passed 83 suites and 796 tests, plus 57 incremental-ledger tests, type checking, lint with zero errors, and button-contract audit.
Independent final review found no P0, P1, or P2 findings on the exact staged candidate.
risks: A physical platform keyboard can report a frame sequence not represented by the local React Native event mocks.
A missing or stale generation check could scroll a newly opened form using geometry from an older form session.
An inapplicable field must remain absent rather than being serialized as null, while a blank applicable field must remain explicit null.
The historical ledger remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is not included in this candidate.
